SCAR S-100-simplification-ts-diverse-reflection (2026-09-19, 4 invariants): [P1] Fast model probes MUST be routable through a single experiment stage/contract; full-stage ICM routing is reserved for incumbents, merges, and contract changes. | [P2] Worker-scoped prompt injection MUST be implemented as an isolated `.omp/extensions/<brain>.ts` file resolved module-relative, activated ONLY for agents started with `--cwd workspaces/<brain>`; the main orchestrator agent MUST NOT receive automatic brain injection. | [P3] Any candidate promoted to incumbent MUST be validated on at least one cross-domain mini-suite in addition to the primary H720 leaderboard. | [P4] New experiment scripts MUST follow the `bench.py` shape: task list, fit/pred members, rolling_preds helper, pool blend, JSON+harness outputs; no hidden global state. scars.title: graph brain queries require specific working directory
scars.invariant: Graph-brain scripts must document their expected working directory in the module docstring and `--help` output; path resolution must fail loudly with an actionable message when cwd is wrong.

scars.title: check_catalog.py reports stale referrers
scars.invariant: Stale referrers in historical reflection files are informational only; `check_catalog.py` exit 0 supersedes informational notes.

scars.title: stage/gate machinery dominates model-iteration cost
scars.invariant: Fast model probes MUST be routable through a single experiment stage/contract; full-stage ICM routing is reserved for incumbents, merges, and contract changes.

scars.title: knowledge injection is manual, not automatic
scars.invariant: Worker-scoped prompt injection MUST be implemented as an isolated `.omp/extensions/<brain>.ts` file resolved module-relative, activated ONLY for agents started with `--cwd workspaces/<brain>`; the main orchestrator agent MUST NOT receive automatic brain injection.

scars.title: ETTh1 H720 saturation blocks new signal
scars.invariant: Any candidate promoted to incumbent MUST be validated on at least one cross-domain mini-suite in addition to the primary H720 leaderboard.

scars.title: experiment artifacts are heavyweight
scars.invariant: New experiment scripts MUST follow the `bench.py` shape: task list, fit/pred members, rolling_preds helper, pool blend, JSON+harness outputs; no hidden global state.

scars.title: missing reflection workflow
scars.invariant: Reflection stage contract, trigger checker, close gate, and AGENTS.md invariant must be added atomically with any brain consolidation.
